{{Quote|<nowiki></nowiki>''Repulsor technology'', in the right hands, is a marvellous thing. It is most famous for powering anti-gravity vehicles like my humble hoversled.|Tagta the Hutt|<ref name="gonh">{{TCWComicCite|6.13|The Guns of Nar Hekka}}</ref>
}}
A '''hoversled''', '''hoverpod''', '''sleigh''', '''float sled''', '''gravsled''', or '''repulsor sled''', was any type of hovering [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] vehicle used for the transportation of personnel and equipment, similar in design to a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], but optimized for carrying large quantities of cargo rather than an emphasis on speed.

==History==
Hoversleds were commonly used commercially, though the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] also made use of them.

[[File:Repulsor_sled.jpg|thumb|left|240px|A [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on a hoversled]]
Another variant, the repulsorsled, was often used by [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] as some members of the species had considerable difficulty moving around unaided. Older Hutts, such as [[Aruk Besadii Aora|Aruk]], would increasingly rely on their repulsorsleds as they grew increasingly corpulent. One Hutt used such a vehicle to transport himself and several slaves purchased from [[Clan Secura]], including young [[Aayla Secura/Legends|Aayla Secura]].

The [[Platoon Attack Craft/Legends|Platoon Attack Craft]] was a type of hoversled, and was used by to transport [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droidsto]] the battlefield.

Some hoversleds, often called '''gravsleds''' or '''grav pellets''', were simple, flat vehicles used to move bulky and heavy materials; such as containers of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] in the slave-labor spice-processing plants of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] prior to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

Among the advantages of hoversleds over traditional sleds were that they encountered no resistance from the ground friction and could transport cargo easily, safely, and inexpensively over short distances.
[[File:grav_pellet.jpg|thumb|Pieces of the [[Map to the Valley of the Jedi]] are loaded on [[Jerec (Inquisitor)|Jerec's]] [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda-class shuttle]].]]
In late [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], while attempting to deliver the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], used a hoversled as a diversion to draw away several competing [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters who were attempting to steal Solo and his accompanying reward away from Fett. The hunters were dismayed to discover that Solo's carbonite slab was not atop the hoversled, as they originally believed.

Some [[farmer/Legends|farmers]] on [[Sulon/Legends|Sulon]] used gravsleds for transportation around the countryside.<ref name="Dark Forces: Rebel Agent">''[[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent]]''</ref>
